title: Record delegation worktree retention in a host-owned field instead of parsing result notes
outcome: Whether a delegation's worktree is kept is decided from a host-owned record that a child cannot write, and recording it does not change a signed reviewer result.
acceptance: The sweep's 'already retained' decision reads a host-owned field or attempt marker, not result.notes, so a child's own 'Notes:' line cannot suppress inspection.
Recording a retention reason does not change the terminal result that review-custody retention signs; a reviewer follow-up after a retention gets no spurious custody conflict.
Behavioural tests cover a child note imitating the retention prefix and a reviewer delegation with an isolated worktree that is retained.
